{{Vanilla|Brick}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''brick''' is a fired clay item. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] bricks are an early necessity: they make the [[oven]] and [[bowl]]s.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
A clay ball cooked on [[Kindling|kindling]] or in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] becomes a brick (5 seconds); the vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/brick_from_smoking_clay_ball.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> A block of [[bricks]] crafts back into 2 bricks, and a [[terracotta]] into 4.

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Four bricks make 2 blocks of [[bricks]]; five make 4 [[bowl]]s.
